Coins Coins Coins
=======
***
## General
This simple mod adds several types of coins (and new nuggets) to create an economy system or to be used as rewards in quests.

***

### 💰 Full Coin Economy Table (Based on 1 Diamond = $100)

| 💎 **Material**   | 💵 **Coin Value** | 💵💵 **Coin Pile Value**  | 📦 **Value per Ingot** |
|-------------------|-------------------|----------------------------|------------------------|
| 🟫 **Copper**     | $0.015            | $0.14                      | $0.14                  |
| ⚙️ **Iron**       | $0.14             | $1.23                      | $1.23                  |
| 🟡 **Gold**       | $1.23             | $11.11                     | $11.11                 |
| 💎 **Diamond**    | $11.11            | $100                       | $100                   |
| 💚 **Emerald**    | $100              | $900                       | $900                   |
| 🖤 **Netherite**  | $900              | $8,100                     | $8,100                 |
| 🟨 **Ancient**    | $8,100            | N.A.                       | N.A.                   |

***
